searchText: Hello, do anyone know how voluntary exit with epochs in a previous fork should behave? Consensus tests suggests that it is a special case but the specs do not specify what to do in that case or maybe I am missing it https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/dev/specs/phase0/beacon-chain.md#voluntary-exits and https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/dev/specs/phase0/beacon-chain.md#get_domain tl;dr is that if you sign an exit message for the current epoch, the message is valid for current and next fork (i.e signature check is correct). And id you sign with anything before (e.g. epoch 1), the signature is valid for the current fork only uh ok thanks https://github.com/eth-clients/eth2-networks/pull/83

excerpts.content: tl;dr is that if you sign an exit message for the current epoch, the message is valid for current and next fork (i.e signature check is correct). And id you sign with anything before (e.g. epoch 1), the signature is valid for the current fork only
